name: AINewTool

sources.title: AINewTool homepage - AI tool directory ('Where AI Rising Stars Get Discovered')
AINewTool - Pricing (free badge-gated plan, Pro $9.9 one-time, Sponsor $19.9/mo)

conditions: Free plan ($0) gives 1 dofollow link but REQUIRES badge verification: you must embed the AINewTool badge on your site and 'keep badge permanently - check regularly & unpublish if removed'

Pro plan ($9.9 one-time) removes the backlink requirement and lists immediately ('List right now, publish whenever you want'), with >=3 dofollow links, featured placement, and newsletter/social sharing; Sponsor ($19.9/mo) adds site-wide banner promotion
requirements: AI tool / startup directory - submit via /submit after registering at /auth/register (registration page is a JS app; sign-in appeared on the submit flow)
For the free tier: embed their badge/backlink on the submitted website and keep it live permanently
Product fields typical of this directory family: name, URL, description, categories/tags (the site organizes by categories like AI, Productivity, Development, etc.)
preparation: Account email (and possibly Google/GitHub OAuth - sister sites on the same stack offer these)
Product name, URL, description, category picks
Placement spot for their badge/backlink on your site if taking the free route
Pro plan decision upfront if you don't want the permanent badge obligation
workflow: Go to https://ainewtool.site/submit and fill the product form
Choose the free plan (add their badge to your site before/after submitting; they verify it) or pay Pro $9.9 for badge-free instant listing
Free route: wait for review within 30 days; keep the badge live - 'check regularly & unpublish if removed' means they re-crawl and delist if the badge disappears
watchFor: Badge obligation is permanent and monitored - removing the badge gets the listing unpublished
Promo banner: '50% OFF for PRO & SPONSOR ... EB50 ... Only 4/5 left' - a scarcity-style upsell
Registration/submit pages are JS-rendered - text-only fetches return empty shells
Sister-stack pattern: ainewtool.site shares its layout/badge model with newtool.site and similar directories - same traps apply
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on ainewtool.site and appears in Latest Products/category browsing
unknowns: Whether free-tier review ever exceeds 30 days
Whether the account supports OAuth providers
